html:
Willingham is known for analog animations made in the real world rather than on a screen. We have previously featured his paper cutouts and stencils, where hand-made pieces are lined up against real backdrops and brought to life in camera. This time the building blocks are movie posters, turning a piece of film marketing into motion art. It is a playful fan homage, and a reminder of how much patience and planning goes into a few seconds of handmade animation.

Credits
Artist: Rudy Willingham
Technique: Drive-by stop-motion animation made from 245 Dune movie posters
Music: “Desert Chant” (Dune: Part Three) by Hans Zimmer
Released: November 2026
